description: Join us if you are passionate about space, science,technology, innovation. Our goal is to bring together curious minds
summary:
The Forgotten Frontier is a website I created to share some of the interesting stories and discoveries from space exploration that people may not know much about. While learning about space missions, I became interested in the stories behind the objects and equipment left on the Moon and Mars.

Through this website, I wanted to bring those stories together in one place. It includes information about the Apollo missions, the Eagle Lunar Module, the Lunar Laser Ranging Retroreflector, and NASA's Ingenuity helicopter on Mars. I have also included interactive maps and other sections to make exploring more interesting.

My main aim is to help people learn about the lesser-known side of space exploration in a simple and engaging way.
details:
The Forgotten Frontier is an interactive space exploration museum created to help people discover the lesser-known stories behind important space missions and discoveries.

The website brings together stories about Apollo 11, the Eagle Lunar Module, the Lunar Laser Ranging Retroreflector, and NASA's Ingenuity helicopter on Mars. It also includes an interactive lunar map, timelines, and different sections that allow visitors to explore space history in an interesting way.

The main idea behind this project is to show that space exploration is not just about launching rockets and reaching other planets. There are many fascinating stories behind the equipment, discoveries, and technologies used in these missions.

I created the website using an AI website builder and used Netlify to host it online. I wanted to make space history simple, accessible, and enjoyable for anyone interested in exploring the universe.
dataRefs: Retroreflectors: From Apollo to Mars – NASA
